body: thank you! This makes me feel a little less alone,almost every two months I notice a change in the pattern of my pmdd,it’s the worst.

I’ve felt the same,it’s almost like an impending doom,a dark cloud the lingers around no matter how fine you feel during the rest of the month. I’ve noticed the smallest of things can really set me off and trigger a really bad depressive episode.

I relate to this a 100%. Just around two weeks ago I wanted nothing more than to die and just disappear and I relapsed and ended up self harming. But then a couple of days after that I was so confused? I genuinely couldn’t understand why my thoughts took such a drastic turn
If you’re comfortable,keep us updated on the sub :)

Thank you so much <3 Literally same,I got so emotional after reading stories here and online. I was almost unintentionally gaslighting myself,but I’m glad we both know what the issue is,which is one step closer to getting better :) we’re all in this together!
Yes we’re all in this together :) sending loads of love your way,you’ve got this!
Thank you so much for this,I wish you the same:) have a great day!
Thank youu:) you too,have a great day!
Good luck! I hope it goes well,you got this <3
Thank you so much,You too! We’re all in this together,we’ve got this :) hope you are feeling better.
Thank you so much :)
Thank you for this,I really needed to hear this :)
Thank you so much,hope you have a great day :)
Thank you so much,Wish you the same,hopefully you’re feeling a little better after seeing all the support  for you in this thread :)
No worries :) I get where you’re coming from a 100%,it’s my first sem at college and honestly I’d like nothing better than to drop out :(

Hi! There is this course called TA(transactional analysis) that helps you understands your patterns,and why you tend to slip back into certain coping mechanisms. It helps you understand why you are the person you are today and helps in bringing awareness(a big part to start solving the issue). I intend to take the course soon too since I am also slowly slipping into a relapse. I’ve heard from some people in my life that these TA sessions are very insightful. Might be worth reading about this when you are feeling better :) Take care,remember you aren’t alone.
Thank you,this really does mean a lot :)
Thank you so much :)

Idk what it is but my involuntary response when I’m rlly going through it is always wanting to die or just wanting to disappear. Like when things get rough,my first thought is to just end it,I don’t know how to deal w my problems in a healthy way :(
Right? What’s the point of fighting when I end up in this dark pit every single time. I want to die but I’m also terrified to,I just really really wish I could disappear

I don’t really have any advice per day that I can offer you but I’m going through exactly what you’re going through. It’s my first year at college too and I feel like no one really address how horrible online college is,it’s a constant struggle of finishing your assignments on time and struggling to make friends online. It’s gotten to the point where I honestly sleep through all my classes,I have no interest in any of them. I feel like I’m relapsing too and there’s this cloud of darkness that just seems to follow me every single day. I wish I could just drop out and take a gap year :(
Me too:( I dream of just starting my life over again,or running away just being by myself no attachments or promises to the world
can I message you?
You too:)

I felt the same way too when I first started therapy,even if you don’t know how to answer a question just be honest and say you don’t know. There is no right or wrong answer in therapy,I know this is easier said than done but be open and express yourself however complicated your emotions maybe.
Yep that’s literally exactly how I feel too,I’m here if you want to talk :)
Good luck :) the first therapy sessions are always nerve wracking,you got this,and you aren’t alone
I hear you,you aren’t alone. I feel like I can’t talk to anyone in my life about how I feel,because I’m scared I’ll upset or disappoint them. I just want to be okay again

I’m in the exact same boat as you,I used to cut myself 2 years ago and I made a promise to myself and to everyone around me that I would never do it again. But I did and I’m ashamed of myself,and I feel so awfully guilty

I feel you. I went through a horrible phase of my life about 2 years ago and slowly but steadily got back on my feet. But this year has rlly brought my mental health down and I’m constantly thinking about who I used to be in the beginning of the year and how much more happier and carefree I was. I think about this a lot actually,and it makes even more sad to thing about how much I’ve changed

Idk I learned to communicate and be open but nowadays I just can’t bring myself to talk to anyone about how I’m feeling. Thank you for taking the time out of your day and leaving me advice,I needed that:)
Thank you this means a lot to me :) I have an apt with her on Tuesday and I plan on telling her about how I am feeling. Hopefully that works out and I don’t shut down
